requirements.text: Provide real-time notifications for every transaction
Implement biometric authentication using fingerprint and facial recognition
Enable instant card controls for freezing/unfreezing cards and setting spending limits
Streamline in-app lending and credit applications process
All new features must integrate with existing legacy core banking system without major changes
Ensure compliance with PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication requirements
Store and process all customer financial data within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR
Maintain backward compatibility with the existing app for at least six months during the transition
